scientific_integrity: The lower bound is three-output counting and the upper bound is an explicit finite-template construction proved for all alphabet sizes; finite executions are checks, not the source of the infinite quantifier. Existing binary perfect-covering constructions are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for length-four words, deletion of exactly one adjacent pair of symbols, and unrestricted (not necessarily linear) q-ary codebooks. No claim for general length or arbitrary two deletions.
title: Exact all-alphabet length-four two-burst-deletion covering number
